text: TDK Corporation is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Its principal shareholders as of 31 March 2026 were custodial trust accounts: The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account) 27.01% and Custody Bank of Japan (trust account) 11.73%; the Government of Norway held 1.29%, below 5%.
short: TDK is listed in Tokyo; its largest disclosed holders are custodial trust accounts.
